**ACCEPT** — PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/11767. ⛔ NOT enqueued: `needs:contract-review` is hung on both carriers and this seat cannot clear it (see the fuse reading at the end).

Review of record — verified against GitHub and the branch, not the report's self-description:

- **PR shape**: draft ✓, base `main` ✓, `Fixes #11739` / `Part of #11723` as the first two body lines ✓. 39 files; `packages/platform-objects` untouched as claimed; the declared deviations (error-code ledger, `public-auth-features.ts`, `migrations/**`, regenerated artifacts, docs) are all mechanically obliged by the gates the card named.
- **Default is the ruled one, with no limbo**: `resolveAudience(undefined)` returns `invite_only`; an off-vocabulary posture ALSO returns `invite_only` plus an `invalid` marker that refuses admission with `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` — fail-closed in both directions, and it never coerces a typo into a permissive branch (the `MembershipPolicy` precedent's whole point).
- **Invitation carve-out is correctly bounded**: keyed on `status: 'pending'`, exact email match after trim+lowercase, expiry enforced, and the `catch` returns `false` so an error falls back to the posture. It grants no permission set. One real defect found here and filed as #11770 rather than sent back (fail-closed, bounded): the lookup reads at most 200 pending rows and scans in memory, so past 200 concurrently-pending invitations the invitation lane silently stops admitting.
- **The strongest evidence in this PR is the vendor-shield measurement.** better-auth 1.7.1's sign-up route converts a 403 from the `validateUserInfo` admission seam into a synthetic 200 whenever `requireEmailVerification` is on — and this card's own invariant FORCES verification on for every self-registration-permitting posture, so the gate would have been inert exactly where it matters, with nothing red. The dev measured it (scratch repro logging the gate's verdict beside `STATUS 200`), raised the same decision function in the `/sign-up/email` before-hook, and pinned it red→green. That is the ADR-0078 "valid-but-inert" failure mode caught by measurement rather than by reasoning.
- **Creation-class routing is a real design judgement and it is defensible**: operator (`admin`/`scim`) and provider (`sso-oidc`/`sso-saml`, plus `oauth` whose providerId is an operator-registered `oidcProviders` entry) are exempt; social OAuth and every UNRECOGNIZED method are posture-gated, so a future creation path fails closed. The exemption is load-bearing, not a hole: gating IdP JIT would brick every SSO-enforced fleet the moment the ruled `invite_only` default lands, and IdP registration is itself a platform-admin act — for the cloud platform IdP the cross-tenant wall is the OP-side app-assignment gate (`oidc-authorize-gate.ts`, membership-or-creator, fail-closed), which I read independently earlier today.
- **Semantic worth stating plainly** (documented, not a defect): `invite_only` means "no self-registration via credentials or social" — federated users from an operator-registered IdP still JIT in. A stricter value is a future vocabulary addition, not a bug in this PR.
- **Gates**: 40 in the dispatch-gates family, 39 green; the single red is `check:objectui-changeset`'s self-test needing `mapfile` (absent on this macOS bash 3.2 host, exit 127) — environmental, not a verdict on the diff, and CI owns it on Linux. `check-changeset-no-major` green and `check-adr-0087-registration` reports the declared-breaking changeset carrying its disposition, so the ruled `minor` tier is mechanically confirmed. Verify-lock printed its lock-unusable verdict on this host; all heavy runs were declared UNLOCKED.

**Clause-② / contract review — the fuse fired, so this stops here.** The diff touches `packages/spec/src/**` (path limb) and the card was claimed `Clause-②: yes` (content limb: a configuration previously accepted is now refused, and the authorable surface widened). Dispatch tier was `claude-fable-5`, but `mode:subagent` tier is not self-provable, so the review chain applies regardless. This seat's own served model, machine-read from the host-recorded transcript field rather than self-described, is now **`claude-opus-5`** — the session model was changed mid-round — against `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER = 'claude-fable-5'`. Reading ≠ tier ⇒ this seat SKIPS the contract review entirely and leaves the label in place. The card waits outside the queue, which is the safe state. Clearing requires a reviewer measured at the contract-review tier.

**Contract review: PASS** — PR #11767 at head `38e5fea48`. Reviewed the actual diff (schema, decision module, manager wiring, ledger, migration entry, manifests) against the card's ruled contract:

- **Vocabulary and default**: closed enum `invite_only | email_domain | open`, undeclared ⇒ `invite_only` with no limbo, following the `MembershipPolicy` precedent exactly — runtime value list, `isAudiencePosture()` guard, and off-vocabulary values refused loudly at entry and refused again (`AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR`, never coerced to a permissive branch) if smuggled past it.
- **Invariant 1** (self-reg-permitting ⇒ verification forced): explicit `requireEmailVerification: false` beside an open posture is refused at boot AND at `applyConfigPatch` (merged-result validation, whole-object replace so stale siblings cannot be manufactured); the wiring forces the flag on and `getPublicConfig()` mirrors it, so the advertised and wired values cannot disagree. Enforcement is at the boot door of the card's "parse/boot" disjunction, with the schema carrying every same-object invariant.
- **Invariant 2** (email_domain ⇒ non-empty list) and the inert-declaration refusals both directions (ADR-0078) live in the Zod schema and are mirrored at entry; the domain matcher's five rules are stated and test-locked as the card demanded.
- **Invariant 3** (explicit permission set): required at declaration, `admin_full_access` refused, a dangling set refuses admission at decision time (fail closed, `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` distinct from policy refusals), and the grant demonstrably lands (`sys_user_permission_set`, idempotent, org-scoped, durability-level report on failure).
- **Invariant 4** (one point, distinct registered codes): `decideAudienceAdmission()` is the single pure decision owner, wired at better-auth's `user.validateUserInfo` seam covering every creation path. The additional raise in the `/sign-up/email` before-hook is not a spread of the check but the same decision function raised where the vendor's anti-enumeration shield was MEASURED converting the 403 into a synthetic 200 — the exact valid-but-inert failure this card exists to close, caught by measurement; the two call sites cannot diverge because the decision is one function. `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` / `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` are registered in the ADR-0112 ledger.
- **Creation-class routing** (the dispatch's SSO-JIT determination): operator (`admin`/`scim`) and operator-registered-IdP JIT exempt, social OAuth and every unrecognized method posture-gated fail-closed — the exemption is load-bearing (the closed vocabulary cannot otherwise express closed-self-reg + IdP-JIT) and the unrecognized-method floor keeps future creation paths behind the wall. The invitation carve-out is correctly bounded (pending + unexpired + exact lowercased match, error ⇒ fall back to posture, no grant), and its known population cap is filed as #11770 in the fail-closed direction rather than ridden here.
- **Posture of the change**: `minor` under the launch-window rule with the ADR-0087 semantic entry registered (`rest-requireauth-default-flip` class — a secure-default flip no transform can decide), and the PR body publishes the dedicated consumer section (field shape, vocabulary, error codes, accessor, backfill note) that objectstack-ai/cloud#1649 consumes verbatim — the card's hard requirement.

Tier reading this round: `get_session.external_metadata.last_served_model = claude-fable-5` = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (read fresh from origin/main `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:3070`) — this is the tier-qualified review the dispatching seat's fired fuse (its own reading `claude-opus-5`) correctly left this card waiting for. Standing authorization: maintainer 2026-08-23 「要不还是你挂个定时处理审核吧」. Clearing `needs:contract-review` from both carriers in this stroke; enqueue and CI convergence remain the dispatching seat's per its ACCEPT.
